checkpoint.title: Presentation boundary and ImGui renderer upgrade surface

goal: Move swapchain/present ownership into PresentationSurface, hide ImGuiViewport resource ownership inside ImGuiIntegration, and reduce public UI integration to one render-owned surface.
fixed_decisions: Extra ImGui viewport presentation remains independent RHI submits in this milestone.
Renderer/editor code must not own raw ImGuiViewport framebuffer or swapchain access.
RHI swapchain creation must not call WindowContext.

tasks.title: Introduce PresentationSurface for main window
work: Make PresentationSurface own main-window SwapchainRef, extent, format, resize sync, and present request creation.
Replace Renderer base direct SwapchainCreateInfo construction with PresentationSurface construction from a native window descriptor.
Move main-window present-source extent/format validation into PresentationSurface.
must_be_true: Main-window present cannot consume a detached/platform viewport framebuffer.
Resize behavior is centralized through PresentationSurface.

tasks.title: Remove WindowContext dependency from RHI swapchain creation
work: Replace SwapchainCreateInfo raw uintptr_t window_handle dependency with explicit backend-neutral surface creation data or callback.
Make VulkanSwapChain receive surface creation data without calling WindowContext.
must_be_true: Surface creation ownership is outside RHI backend internals.

tasks.title: Move ImGui platform viewport presentation to PresentationSurface
work: Replace GuiViewportData raw swapchain/framebuffer ownership with PresentationSurface ownership.
Keep official imgui_impl_glfw platform window creation and map ImGuiViewport to private PresentationSurface records inside ImGuiIntegration.
Move platform viewport resize, framebuffer availability, and present-source validation into PresentationSurface.
Keep platform viewport present as independent RHI submits.
must_be_true: ImGuiViewport to PresentationSurface mapping is private to ImGuiIntegration.
Renderer passes never receive ImGuiViewport pointers.
Detached Scene Color output cannot override the main present source.
Platform viewport present remains independently submitted.

tasks.title: Collapse ImGui renderer public upgrade surface
work: Remove unused duplicate UIRenderer surfaces and pass-through wrappers.
Expose one render-owned UI integration surface used by editor and profiler where practical.
Keep public UI surface limited to lifecycle, ImGuiIOInput snapshot access, image registration, draw recording, platform viewport update, and platform present.
Keep ImGui version-sensitive calls and imgui_impl_glfw includes inside the ImGui integration module.
must_be_true: Editor and profiler do not maintain incompatible ImGui lifecycle paths when a shared path is practical.
Renderer, RHI, WindowSystem, and editor input policy do not include ImGui backend headers.
No wrapper exists only to forward calls without owning lifecycle, resource, or ordering invariants.

exit_gate: PresentationSurface owns main and platform viewport swapchains.
VulkanSwapChain no longer depends on WindowContext.
Editor/renderer code does not expose raw ImGuiViewport framebuffer ownership.
Public UI integration surface is reduced to one render-owned path.
just r starts and presentation smoke coverage passes.
validation: Run just r after a successful build.
Manual runtime coverage: main resize, Scene Color detach, detached resize, minimize/restore, re-dock, renderer switch, profiler startup if available, and shutdown.

summary: PresentationSurface now owns main and ImGui platform viewport swapchains, framebuffer allocation, resize, sync, and present request creation.
VulkanSwapChain consumes explicit surface creation data and no longer includes or calls WindowContext.
Editor/UI public API no longer exposes raw ImGuiViewport framebuffer lookup, and the unused legacy global UI renderer path was deleted.
